svg.title: 0.5 kg voice-controlled pulsator washer — V0.1 reference dimensions
svg.desc: Four schematic engineering views with external English annotations: front section, right side, top view and a machined shaft-seal section. Dimensions are design references in millimetres, not measured fabrication data. Overall height 509 including 34 feet; body 340 wide, 380 deep and 475 high. Dedicated notes describe the rear electronics enclosures, build dimensions, drain route and prototype limitations.
svg.text: All dimensions in mm • Schematic; not to scale
E1–E4 refer to the dedicated enclosure notes below.
Machined load-bearing assembly; not a printed part
Route to the leak collection tray.
The printed parts provide support and trim.
Water protection relies on the purchased boxes, continuous partition / canopy and sealed cable glands.
Nominal radial clearance to the tub wall: 27.5 per side.
Shell walls and structural ribs: 4. Panels sized for a
220 × 220 print bed; M3 / M4 heat-set brass inserts.
Ø12 metal shaft; 2 × 6001-2RS bearings; 2 × FKM seals.
Do not print the shaft, bearing seats or coupling.
2 × RSF46 mounted through the actual tub wall.
Six-point sloped drainage to two recessed RSF54 wells.
ID20 → coarse filter / gravity branch → 88 × 112 × 56 isolated side chamber + LLF59 → 24 V pump → anti-siphon high loop.

g.text: Structural envelope only — not a procurement or fabrication drawing.
The control box sits below the maximum water level: a known V1 deviation. Measure the actual tub, seals, motor, pump and sensors,
then verify the complete assembly for water protection. Low-speed wash prototype; high-speed spin is prohibited.

svg.text: 0.5 kg functional prototype / Reference envelope / V0.1
